summary: Paisley Fire Tower, Lake County FL: a 115-ft steel tower described in a 1968 survey record and shown on a map; no source confirms it stands today.

facts.status_note: Last described in a 1968 survey record; no recent source confirms the tower stands.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one 1968 National Geodetic Survey station description (carried on Forest Lookouts), one TopoZone map listing with no date, and one Wikipedia line for location. No build date, staffing, fate or current condition found. The Florida former-lookout register on firetower.org lists six sites and none is Paisley. The Orlando Sentinel 1998 Paisley fire story and the Florida History Blog Paisley page were checked and do not mention the tower. The record's agency field held a source note; proposed correction given. No photos found.
